nodes.code:
# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ── import json import re import datetime from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo # Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level. BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json" BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients" BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules" BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills" BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox" BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed" BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed" BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail" def bk_fmt(amount, currency=""): if amount is None: return "—" return (currency + " " if currency else "") + "{:,.2f}".format(amount) # ── Publish the digest ── import html as _html problem = params.get("problem") or "" summary = params.get("summary") or {} artifact_url = "" if not problem: clients = summary.get("clients") or [] commentary = "" if clients: commentary = api.ai.generate( prompt=("You write the weekly accounts payable note for an Australian bookkeeping team. In 3 to 5 short " "bullet points, say what needs attention this week: overdue bills, bills waiting for review or " "approval, and exceptions. Name the businesses. Use only the numbers given; don't add advice."), input=json.dumps(summary)[:28000], ) def cell(pair): return str(pair[0]) + " · " + bk_fmt(pair[1]) if pair[0] else "—" rows = [] for c in clients: rows.append( "" + _html.escape(str(c.get("name") or "")) + "" + "" + (str(c["in_review"]) if c["in_review"] else "—") + "" + "" + (str(c["exceptions"]) if c["exceptions"] else "—") + "" + "" + cell(c["draft"]) + "" + cell(c["awaiting"]) + "" + "" + cell(c["due_soon"]) + "" + cell(c["overdue"]) + "" + "" + _html.escape(c.get("error") or "") + "" ) bullets = "".join("
  • " + _html.escape(line.lstrip("-•* ").strip()) + "
    • " for line in commentary.splitlines() if line.strip()) page = ( "AP digest " + summary.get("as_of", "") + "" "" "

    Accounts payable digest, " + summary.get("as_of", "") + "

    " + ("
      " + bullets + "
    " if bullets else "") + "" "" + "" + ("".join(rows) or "") + "
    BusinessBills to reviewExceptionsDrafts in XeroAwaiting approvalDue by " + summary.get("due_by", "") + "OverdueNote
    No client businesses are set up yet.
    " "

    Amounts are amounts due from Xero. Generated by Bookkeeping for Xero.

    " ) saved = api.artifacts.put(title="AP digest " + summary.get("as_of", ""), content=page, file_name="ap-digest-" + summary.get("as_of", "") + ".html", kind="document", mime_type="text/html", tags=["bookkeeping", "ap-digest"]) artifact_url = (saved or {}).get("url") or "" recipients = summary.get("recipients") or [] if recipients: overdue = sum(c["overdue"][0] for c in clients) review = sum(c["in_review"] for c in clients) api.notify.send(title="Weekly AP digest is ready", body=(str(review) + " bill(s) to review, " + str(overdue) + " overdue. " + artifact_url).strip(), user_ids=recipients)
